notes: Current Marsannay smaller-geographic-unit naming authority. The cahier permits a cadastral lieu-dit name only when it also appears on the harvest declaration. BIVB site identity alone therefore never authorizes the claim.

marsannay_masa_2020_lieu_dit_label.scope: Marsannay cahier des charges, presentation and labeling rule permitting a smaller geographic unit only when it is a cadastral lieu-dit and appears on the harvest declaration.

rules.notes: Positive label authority requires the physical BIVB-listed Marsannay identity plus explicit lot-level evidence that the name is cadastral and appears on the harvest declaration.
Marsannay Rosé named-site label authority is documentary, not inferred from the BIVB site list. Both cadastral status and harvest-declaration use must be supplied for the lot.
